lines.zh: 翼龙兽贴着山脊滑过去
它的双翼张开，几乎不动
lines.en: Its wings spread and barely move.

lines.zh: 它的影子扫过整片山坡
lines.en: Its shadow sweeps the whole slope.
It folds its wings and dives.

lines.zh: 它绕着一座尖峰转了半圈
lines.en: It loops halfway around a peak.
It drops low over the dunes.

lines.zh: 它朝你所在的方向掠过
lines.en: It sweeps past in your direction.

lines.zh: 翼龙兽落在岩台上，收翅
lines.en: Pteranomon lands on a ledge and folds its wings.
It shakes out its wing edges.
Its head hangs low, watching below.
It lifts its head to the sky.

lines.zh: 风把它的翼缘吹得轻响
lines.en: The wind rattles its wing edges.

lines.zh: 它把身体转了一个角度
lines.en: It turns its body to an angle.

lines.zh: 它的脚爪在石上抓了抓
它的影子在岩台上来回
lines.en: Its shadow moves across the ledge.
It seems to be waiting for wind.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛一直看着远处
lines.en: Its eyes stay on the distance.

lines.zh: 翼龙兽低头，眼睛对着你
lines.en: Pteranomon lowers its head at you.
It stands up on the ledge.

lines.zh: 它似乎把你归成了猎物
lines.en: It seems to have classed you as prey.

lines.zh: 它把身体朝你的方向压
lines.en: It leans its body your way.

lines.zh: 它发出一声低而长的响
lines.en: It gives a long, low cry.
It gives you a last glance.
Then it springs off the ledge.

lines.zh: 翼龙兽歪了一下，退了半步

lines.en: A split opens in a wing edge.

lines.zh: 它发出一声短促的尖叫
它的脚爪在地上抓了一下

lines.en: But it gives no real ground.

lines.zh: 翼龙兽盯着你手上的肉

lines.en: It lowers its head far down.

lines.zh: 它落地后朝你走了两步
lines.en: It lands and takes two steps.
It tips its head back and swallows.
Done, it lowers its head again.

lines.zh: 它的目光又回到你的手
lines.en: Its gaze returns to your hands.

lines.zh: 它把肉叼到岩台上去吃
lines.en: It carries the meat up to the ledge to eat.

lines.zh: 吃完它把喙在石上擦了擦
lines.en: Done, it wipes its beak on the stone.

lines.zh: 翼龙兽撞过来，把你掀退
lines.en: Pteranomon slams in and knocks you back.
Its wing edge rakes your shoulder.
It lands in a blast of sand.
It pulls back, wings half spread.
It lines up on you again.
Its cry is short and harsh.
It waits for the next strike.

lines.zh: 两只翼龙兽在空中交错
lines.en: Two pteranomon cross in the air.
They fly level for a stretch.

lines.zh: 它们落在同一块岩台上
lines.en: They land on the same ledge.

lines.zh: 它们并排站着，看着山下
风把它们的翼缘吹得轻响
lines.en: The wind rattles both their edges.
It tips its head back to swallow.

lines.zh: 它对不合口的东西丢开

lines.en: It carries it up to the ledge.

lines.zh: 它张开双翼，张开到最大
lines.en: It spreads its wings to full span.
A shriek cuts across the slope.

lines.zh: 它的影子一下就到你脚边
lines.en: Its shadow reaches your feet at once.
It climbs to set up a dive.
It has chosen the landing point.
Each circle drops it another block.

lines.zh: 它试了一次俯冲，又拉起
lines.en: It dives once and pulls up.
It works around to your back.

lines.zh: 它落在一块石上，盯着你
lines.en: It lands on a stone and stares.

lines.zh: 它把身体压低，准备再起
翼龙兽俯冲而下，爪先到
它的翼缘切过你的手臂
lines.en: A wing edge cuts your arm.
It lands and shoves you back.
Its long tail sweeps across your ribs.
Missing, it pulls up at once.
The second strike comes in steeper.

lines.zh: 它用爪子抓着你的护甲
它的翅膀扇得你站不稳

lines.en: It pulls away and re-lines up.
It has no intention of stopping.

lines.zh: 山脊上有一对翅膀张开
lines.en: A pair of wings opens on the ridge.

lines.zh: 翼龙兽从热浪里显出形
lines.en: Pteranomon resolves out of the heat haze.
It springs off the ledge and glides.
Its wing shadow passes your feet.
It loops half around and starts down.
It lands in a sheet of sand.
The slope goes quiet for an instant.

lines.zh: 翼缘被燎到，它猛地腾空
lines.en: A wing edge scorches and it launches up.
It lands and rolls onto its side.

lines.zh: 翼湿透了，它拍打得很吃力
气浪把它掀翻着抛出去
lines.en: The blast throws it tumbling away.

lines.zh: 箭穿过翼膜，留下一个洞
lines.en: An arrow punches a hole through a wing membrane.
Odd force hits and both wings lock.

lines.zh: 饿得飞不稳，它落在地上
lines.en: Too starved to fly straight, it lands.
Lightning strikes and it drops stiff.

lines.zh: 虚空拖它，双翼拼命扇动
lines.en: The void pulls; its wings beat hard.
